queries.purpose: Find checkout latency spikes above 750 ms.
queries.query: search index=main source="splunk-incident-lab:checkout" | spath | search service=checkout-api endpoint="/checkout" latency_ms>750 | dedup trace_id | table _time trace_id status latency_ms message

queries.purpose: Find checkout HTTP errors during the incident window.
queries.query: search index=main source="splunk-incident-lab:checkout" | spath | search service=checkout-api endpoint="/checkout" status>=500 | stats count by status message

queries.purpose: Compare baseline, injected-failure, and recovered checkout health.
queries.query: search index=main source="splunk-incident-lab:checkout" | spath | search service=checkout-api endpoint="/checkout" | stats dc(trace_id) as events avg(latency_ms) as avg_latency_ms max(latency_ms) as max_latency_ms dc(eval(if(status>=500, trace_id, null()))) as errors by scenario_phase

queries.purpose: Verify the controlled fault ground truth is only present during injected failure.
queries.query: search index=main source="splunk-incident-lab:checkout" | spath | search service=checkout-api endpoint="/checkout" root_cause_ground_truth="payment-provider-timeout" | dedup trace_id | table _time trace_id scenario_phase fault_injected status latency_ms message root_cause_ground_truth
